statement: In the fine-tuning study that matches the proposed idea, the isolated-triple and context-augmented arms share the base model, LoRA setup, optimizer, sequence length, batch size, epochs and learning-rate schedule, and there are equal numbers of QA items per regime.

evidence.quote: all four models are initialized from the same base model and trained using the same fine-tuning configuration, LoRA setup, optimizer, sequence length, batch size, number of epochs, and learning-rate schedule.
